title: Breach Exposure by Email Alias
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert alias=*
| stats count as breach_hits, values(breach) as breaches by alias
| sort - breach_hits
description: Shows which email aliases or addresses attract the most breach exposure over time.
value: Alias-level visibility helps you see which signup patterns or services are making your digital life noisier and riskier.
implementation: Ingest breach alerts with alias or account labels; summarize hit counts and breach names per alias.
visualization: Table of aliases ranked by breach exposure count.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which email aliases get exposed in breaches most often, helping you spot the risky corners of your online life.
